exception.label: IRN refused
exception.title: INV/26-27/0001 (Sharma Traders) has no IRN
exception.detail: The IRP refused it: The invoice is 167 days old. Above ₹10 crore turnover the portal refuses anything past 30 days, so this one can no longer be made valid — raise a credit note and re-invoice.. A B2B invoice without an IRN is not a valid tax invoice.

events.note: Found by the scheduler and given to its owner, to deal with by 2026-10-30.
